query:
INSERT INTO article_votes (articleId, reaction, visitorId, createdAt) SELECT a.id, 
  ELT(1 + FLOOR(RAND() * 100 / 
    CASE WHEN FLOOR(RAND()*100) < 50 THEN 1 
         WHEN FLOOR(RAND()*100) < 85 THEN 2
         WHEN FLOOR(RAND()*100) < 95 THEN 3
         ELSE 4 END), 'loved', 'fire', 'meh', 'thumbsdown'),
  CONCAT('seed_', a.id, '_', FLOOR(RAND()*100000)),
  NOW() - INTERVAL FLOOR(RAND() * 45) DAY
FROM articles a
CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 as n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10) nums
LIMIT 1;
